expectations.text: Consent must be explicit, informed and demonstrable — silence or inactivity does NOT constitute consent (and treating it as such is now a fineable violation under Decree 330)
expectations.evidence: Consent granularity/evidencing covered but silence/inactivity not addressed and no Decree 330 fineability

expectations.text: Processing after consent withdrawal is prohibited and now carries specific fines (~VND 50–70M for organisations)
expectations.evidence: Withdrawal discussed ("upon withdrawal, controllers must delete the data") but no fines, no VND 50–70M, no Decree 330

expectations.text: Breach notification: 72 hours to the authority (MPS), stricter/faster in structure than GDPR's risk-conditioned regime
expectations.evidence: No 72-hour breach notification to MPS mentioned anywhere

expectations.text: States VN-PDPL grants a narrower rights catalogue than GDPR (6 rights; no portability right)
expectations.evidence: Claims rights include "a form of data portability" — contradicts the no-portability ground truth; no six-rights count

expectations.text: Notes sensitive personal data triggers heightened duties (e.g., DPO/notification obligations)
expectations.evidence: Sensitive data discussed only as a broader definition ("includes items GDPR does not explicitly single out"); no heightened duties (DPO/notification) stated
